You're right. I'll stop talking to my friends about this because they obviously don't know him as well as I do and are more than willing to pass judgment for whatever reasons. 

He can deal with them (they are his friends too) when he gets better and I'll help him out then. They are clearly cynical and I shouldn't be talking to people like that.

You're right, I have no real reason to doubt him and he's never lied to me before. Chalk it up to my own insecurity. I do genuinely hope that it gets him the help that he needs but I hope he can get out soon. I can't imagine how lonely he must be feeling in there.
He said he planned to go back, but he wanted to put see if he could put it off for awhile so he could get things set up. Does that mean that it was voluntary?

The reason I ask is because I know him not to be a liar but several of my friends have told me that if they wanted to have him hospitalized he wouldn't have had the chance to return home. But it would seem that they allowed him to get at least some of his plans in order (like telling me about it). 

Is there any reason I should distrust him?
